title: Formal card layout
back: Host → *request the pleasure of your company* → occasion → day, date, time → venue → chief guest → RSVP. Third person, centred, no signature.

title: Card or letter?
svg: <svg viewBox="0 0 320 200" role="img" aria-label="Formal = card, third person · Informal = letter, first person" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="1.5" font-size="11"><rect x="30" y="40" width="110" height="120" rx="4"/><text x="85" y="70" text-anchor="middle" font-size="9" fill="currentColor" stroke="none">Host</text><text x="85" y="86" text-anchor="middle" font-size="9" fill="currentColor" stroke="none">request the</text><text x="85" y="98" text-anchor="middle" font-size="9" fill="currentColor" stroke="none">pleasure…</text><text x="85" y="140" text-anchor="middle" font-size="9" font-weight="700" fill="currentColor" stroke="none">RSVP</text><rect x="180" y="40" width="110" height="120" rx="4"/><text x="195" y="60" text-anchor="start" font-size="8" fill="currentColor" stroke="none">12, Hill Road</text><text x="195" y="80" text-anchor="start" font-size="9" fill="currentColor" stroke="none">Dear Sameer,</text><text x="195" y="100" text-anchor="start" font-size="8" fill="currentColor" stroke="none">I'd love you to…</text><text x="195" y="140" text-anchor="start" font-size="9" fill="currentColor" stroke="none">Your friend,</text><text x="160.0" y="194" text-anchor="middle" font-size="11" fill="currentColor" stroke="none">Formal = card, third person · Informal = letter, first person</text></svg>
back: Principal / school / company → formal card. Friend / cousin → informal letter. Writing a letter when a card was asked loses format and content.

title: No Dear, No Yours
svg: <svg viewBox="0 0 320 200" role="img" aria-label="A card ends with RSVP" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="1.5" font-size="11"><text x="100" y="80" text-anchor="middle" font-size="12" font-weight="700" fill="currentColor" stroke="none">Dear Sir,</text><path d="M78,76 L122,76" stroke="#E0B400" stroke-width="2"/><text x="220" y="80" text-anchor="middle" font-size="12" font-weight="700" fill="currentColor" stroke="none">Yours sincerely,</text><path d="M198,76 L242,76" stroke="#E0B400" stroke-width="2"/><rect x="110" y="110" width="100" height="36" rx="6" fill="#E0B400" fill-opacity="0.25"/><text x="160.0" y="132.9" text-anchor="middle" font-size="14" font-weight="700" fill="currentColor" stroke="none">RSVP</text><text x="160.0" y="194" text-anchor="middle" font-size="11" fill="currentColor" stroke="none">A card ends with RSVP</text></svg>
back: A formal card has no salutation and no signature. Ending with *Yours sincerely* and a name is a format error.

title: Day, date, time, venue
svg: <svg viewBox="0 0 320 200" role="img" aria-label="All four, every card" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="1.5" font-size="11"><rect x="60" y="50" width="200" height="90" rx="6"/><text x="160" y="78" text-anchor="middle" font-size="11" font-weight="700" fill="currentColor" stroke="none">Saturday, 20 December 2026</text><text x="160" y="98" text-anchor="middle" font-size="11" font-weight="700" fill="currentColor" stroke="none">at 5 p.m.</text><text x="160" y="118" text-anchor="middle" font-size="11" fill="currentColor" stroke="none">in the school auditorium</text><text x="160.0" y="194" text-anchor="middle" font-size="11" fill="currentColor" stroke="none">All four, every card</text></svg>
back: Giving only *20th* or forgetting the time is a content deduction. Invent a plausible time if the question is silent.

title: Reply = T-O-D
svg: <svg viewBox="0 0 320 200" role="img" aria-label="…then a wish or a reason" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="1.5" font-size="11"><rect x="30" y="70" width="80" height="50" rx="6" fill="#E0B400" fill-opacity="0.25"/><text x="70.0" y="100.6" text-anchor="middle" font-size="16" font-weight="700" fill="currentColor" stroke="none">Thanks</text><rect x="120" y="70" width="80" height="50" rx="6" fill="#E0B400" fill-opacity="0.25"/><text x="160.0" y="100.6" text-anchor="middle" font-size="16" font-weight="700" fill="currentColor" stroke="none">Occasion</text><rect x="210" y="70" width="80" height="50" rx="6" fill="#E0B400" fill-opacity="0.25"/><text x="250.0" y="100.6" text-anchor="middle" font-size="16" font-weight="700" fill="currentColor" stroke="none">Decision</text><text x="160.0" y="194" text-anchor="middle" font-size="11" fill="currentColor" stroke="none">…then a wish or a reason</text></svg>
back: Thank the host, name the occasion and date, say yes or no. For a regret add one brief reason; for an acceptance, a line of anticipation.

title: The regret line
svg: <svg viewBox="0 0 320 200" role="img" aria-label="Formal regret: third person, boxed" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="1.5" font-size="11"><rect x="30" y="45" width="260" height="56" rx="8"/><path d="M46,101 l-6,10 l14,-10"/><text x="160.0" y="60" text-anchor="middle" font-size="10" fill="currentColor" stroke="none">Mr and Mrs Verma regret their inability</text><text x="160.0" y="73" text-anchor="middle" font-size="10" fill="currentColor" stroke="none">to attend owing to a prior commitment.</text><text x="160.0" y="194" text-anchor="middle" font-size="11" fill="currentColor" stroke="none">Formal regret: third person, boxed</text></svg>
back: *…thank … for the kind invitation to [occasion] on [date] … regret their inability to attend owing to … and wish the function every success.*
